performance_data_classification_label.title: Performance Data Classification Label
performance_data_classification_label.description: The data classification label assigned to system performance and characteristics data (e.g., metrics, throughput stats, capacity data, timing profiles). Drives encryption policy applicability and access scoping requirements.

encryption_at_rest_enforced.title: Encryption-at-Rest Enforced for Performance Data
encryption_at_rest_enforced.description: Whether encryption-at-rest controls are enforced on the storage layer where performance metrics and characteristics data are persisted. Covers databases, object stores, log archives, and backup media.

encryption_policy_exemption_granted.title: Encryption Policy Exemption Granted
encryption_policy_exemption_granted.description: Indicates whether a formal exemption from the encryption-at-rest policy has been explicitly granted for this metrics data store, meaning plaintext storage is intentional and documented.

access_scope_restricted.title: Access to Performance Data Is Scoped and Restricted
access_scope_restricted.description: Whether access to performance and characteristics data is restricted to authorized roles rather than broadly available (e.g., all authenticated users or public).

audit_logging_enabled_for_performance_da.title: Audit Logging Enabled for Performance Data Access
audit_logging_enabled_for_performance_da.description: Whether audit logging is enabled and enforced for access and export of performance and characteristics data.

retention_policy_enforced.title: Retention Policy Enforced for Performance Data
retention_policy_enforced.description: Indicates whether an automated lifecycle or expiry policy is configured and actively enforced for performance data, limiting persistent exposure windows.

defined_retention_window_days.title: Defined Retention Window (Days)
defined_retention_window_days.description: The maximum number of days performance data is permitted to be retained per policy. A value of 0 indicates no retention window has been defined.

oldest_record_age_days.title: Oldest Performance Record Age (Days)
oldest_record_age_days.description: Age in days of the oldest retained performance record currently in the data store.

raw_access_scoped_to_authorized_roles_on.title: Raw Performance Data Access Scoped to Authorized Roles Only
raw_access_scoped_to_authorized_roles_on.description: Indicates whether the access control policy restricts raw performance record read permissions exclusively to roles with a documented operational need (e.g., SREs, performance engineers), excluding summary-only roles.

raw_performance_data_reader_roles.title: Roles Granted Raw Performance Data Read Access
raw_performance_data_reader_roles.description: List of roles or identities that have read permissions on raw, unaggregated performance records (e.g., timeseries metrics, throughput logs, anomaly traces).

roles_requiring_only_summary_access.title: Roles That Should Only Access Summarized Reports
roles_requiring_only_summary_access.description: List of roles that, per business requirements or job function, only need access to aggregated or summarized performance reports — not raw records.

cross_team_sharing_enabled.title: Cross-Team or Third-Party Sharing Enabled
cross_team_sharing_enabled.description: Indicates whether performance and characteristics data is shared with other organizational units or third-party vendors.

anonymization_applied.title: Anonymization or Masking Applied Before Sharing
anonymization_applied.description: Indicates whether system-identifying attributes (hostnames, IPs, service identifiers, capacity values) are anonymized, masked, or aggregated before the data is shared externally.

data_granularity_level.title: Granularity of Shared Performance Data
data_granularity_level.description: The level of granularity at which performance and characteristics data is shared — raw individual system metrics versus aggregated or summarized form.

cross_border_transfer_screening_enabled.title: Cross-Border Transfer Screening Enabled
cross_border_transfer_screening_enabled.description: Whether system performance and operational metrics data transferred to offshore analytics platforms or cloud regions is screened against cross-border data transfer obligations before transfer.

destination_region_type.title: Analytics Destination Region Type
destination_region_type.description: Classification of the destination region where system performance metrics are sent for analytics processing, relative to the origin jurisdiction.

applicable_transfer_obligations.title: Applicable Cross-Border Transfer Obligations
applicable_transfer_obligations.description: List of regulatory frameworks, export controls, or sector-specific data residency rules that apply to the operational metrics data being transferred (e.g., ITAR, EAR, GDPR, sector-specific data localisation mandates).

verified_deletion_enforced.title: Verified Deletion Enforced on Disposal
verified_deletion_enforced.description: Whether disposal procedures require and verify cryptographic erasure or secure deletion of performance data on all media types (including backups, archives, and exported snapshots) before decommissioning is considered complete.

disposal_procedure_status.title: Disposal Procedure Completion Status
disposal_procedure_status.description: The current status of the data disposal procedure for decommissioned performance datasets.

residual_data_storage_types.title: Residual Data Storage Media Types
residual_data_storage_types.description: List of storage media types that may still hold performance dataset residuals after decommissioning (e.g., 'backup_tape', 'cloud_snapshot', 'exported_archive', 'offline_disk').
